theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+2.09%) and Materials (+0.42%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-1.87%) and Utilities (-1.24%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.14%, defensives -0.66%, and value/cyclicals +0.23% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.45%, Dow -0.63%, Nasdaq -0.78% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.76%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.58% to 17.20, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.43% to $4,326.40, crude oil was little changed at $105.39, and bitcoin slipped 2.99% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
